production_connectors.architecture_decision: Mixed keyed/latching families: Micro-Lock Plus candidates for signals and Micro-Fit 3.0 candidates for power-bearing interfaces.
production_connectors.critical_finding: The unsafe J_CM5 5 V and external 3.3 V pins were removed and validation now holds it signal-only. The actual 200-pin CM5 carrier, dedicated protected 5 V path, exact GPIO mapping and complete load budget remain absent. The known 5 A CM5 envelope plus 1 A display allowance already consumes the v0.9 6 A converter rating before other loads.
production_connectors.closure_requires: Freeze integrated-versus-separate CM5 carrier architecture; implement and review all used CM5 pins, grounds, GPIO_VREF, sequencing/backfeed protection and high-speed routing; close measured startup/steady/transient load and harness voltage-drop budgets; then verify all production connector/contact/terminal MPNs, pinouts, footprints, mating access and reviewer evidence.
